settings.editor: Paver patios, walkways, driveways, and pool decks. Correct base depth, bedding sand, and edge restraints are what keep pavers from shifting, so that is where the labor goes.

What we set
Interlocking pavers, natural stone, and poured concrete across patios, walkways, driveways, pool decks, and seat walls.

Pet-friendly and putting-green turf for front yards, back yards, and play areas. We remove the old lawn, compact a draining base, then seam, nail, and infill so the lawn stays flat. Backed by a 15-year warranty.

Common jobs
Front lawn replacement, backyard putting greens, dog runs, shaded side yards, and tear-outs of turf laid over the wrong base.

tabs.tab_title: Can I hire just one service?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Artificial grass, pavers, stepping stones, DG, irrigation, and fencing can each be quoted on their own. A full yard combines them under one project manager.

DG is a crushed granite fine used for pathways, patios, and low-water areas. It compacts into a firm natural-looking surface, drains well, and pairs with pavers, stepping stones, and drought-tolerant planting.
